answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 28640 Country: India Title: My question is "IN MY COLLEGE MOSQUE IF WE MISSED THE MAIN JAMAAT OF ZOHAR, WE WANT TO MAKE ANOTHER JAMAAT."WILL WE HAVE TO SAY THE IQAMAT AGAIN OR START THE NAMAZ WITHOUT SAYING IQAMAT AGAIN. Please clarify because more than one jamaats are made in the mosque Question: Assalamualaikum, Mohtaram mufti sahab, my question is "IN MY COLLEGE MOSQUE IF WE MISSED THE MAIN JAMAAT OF ZOHAR, WE WANT TO MAKE ANOTHER JAMAAT."WILL WE HAVE TO SAY THE IQAMAT AGAIN OR START THE NAMAZ WITHOUT SAYING IQAMAT AGAIN. Please clarify because more than one jamaats are made in the mosque. Answer ID: 28640 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 88/86/B=1432) According to Hanafi Fiqh, it is makrooh to do a second jamah in the mosque of locality where five times salah is held with azan and iqamah. Yes, you can do second jama’ah outside the boundary of the mosque. If you hold second jama’ah, the takbir would also be called. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
